title: Sliced-Regularized Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2604.23944v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a new regularized optimal transport (OT) formulation, termed sliced-regularized optimal transport (SROT). Unlike entropic OT (EOT), which regularizes the transport plan toward an independent coupling, SROT regularizes it toward a sliced OT (SOT) plan. To the best of our knowledge, SROT is the first approach to leverage a version of SOT plan as a reference to improve classical OT. We provide a formal definition of SROT, derive its dual formulation, and provide a post-Bayesian interpretation of SROT. We then develop a Sinkhorn-style algorithm for efficient computation. It retains the scalability of EOT and, when the SOT plan is sparse, achieves even lower per-iteration complexity. By incorporating a scalable SOT plan as a prior, SROT yields more accurate approximations of the exact OT plan than EOT under the same level of regularization. Moreover, the resulting transport plan improves upon the reference SOT plan itself

translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新的正则化最优传输（OT）公式，称为切片正则化最优传输（SROT）。与熵正则化最优传输（EOT）将传输计划向独立耦合方向正则化不同，SROT将传输计划向切片最优传输（SOT）计划方向正则化。据我们所知，SROT是首个利用SOT计划的一种形式作为参考来改进经典最优传输的方法。我们给出了SROT的正式定义，推导了其对偶形式，并提供了SROT的后贝叶斯解释。随后，我们开发了一种Sinkhorn风格的高效计算算法。该算法保留了EOT的可扩展性，并且当SOT计划稀疏时，能够实现更低的每次迭代复杂度。通过将可扩展的SOT计划作为先验引入，在相同正则化水平下，SROT比EOT能够更准确地逼近精确的最优传输计划。此外，所得的传输计划还优于作为参考的SOT计划本身。
tldr: 本文提出切片正则化最优传输（SROT），首次以切片最优传输计划作为参考先验来正则化经典最优传输，在保持可扩展性且稀疏情形下复杂度更低的同时，能在相同正则化水平下比熵正则化OT更准确地逼近精确最优传输计划，并且所得传输计划优于参考的切片最优传输计划本身。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Sliced-Regularized Optimal Transport (SROT), the first approach to leverage a sliced OT plan as a reference prior for regularizing classical OT, which retains scalability (with even lower per-iteration complexity when the SOT plan is sparse), yields more accurate approximations of the exact OT plan than entropic OT under the same regularization level, and produces a transport plan that improves upon the reference SOT plan itself.
